sentences: Traders moved $580 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-08-17, across 20.4 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 70% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 30%.
The most-traded market was "Will James Fishback be the Republican nominee for Florida Governor?", pulling in $3 million of volume.

An unusual reversal: retail traders outperformed bots this week. Active retail earned $3K (+332 bps on volume) while algorithms lost $1K (-9 bps). Weeks like this are rare (bots are typically on top by the execution channel).
